verticalPrompts.legal: Clarify practice area, Tennessee jurisdiction, consultation expectations and general-education boundaries.
verticalPrompts.health: Clarify services, credentials, access, emergency routing and privacy without outcome claims.
verticalPrompts.home: Clarify service area, licensing where applicable, estimates, scope and project expectations.
verticalPrompts.auto: Clarify vehicle types, estimate and authorization steps, warranties and safety boundaries.
verticalPrompts.restaurants-hospitality: Clarify hours, service format, accessibility, reservations and date-limited offers.
verticalPrompts.retail: Clarify products, pickup, delivery, returns and current offer dates.
verticalPrompts.professional-services: Clarify expertise, audience, process and the first conversation.
verticalPrompts.accounting-tax: Clarify credentials, secure contact routes, seasonal capacity and document boundaries.
verticalPrompts.education-tutoring: Clarify subjects, age ranges, formats and child-data safeguards.
verticalPrompts.senior-services: Clarify service area, eligibility, accessibility, capacity and vulnerable-user protections.
verticalPrompts.beauty-fitness: Clarify services, scope, credentials, sanitation and responsible outcome language.
verticalPrompts.pet-services: Clarify species, services, credentials, capacity, vaccination rules and emergency boundaries.
verticalPrompts.community-nonprofit: Clarify programs, eligibility, geography, capacity, volunteer needs and public accountability.

guardrails: No guaranteed leads, customers, revenue, savings, ranking or return on investment.
No hidden pay-to-rank or payment-based change to facts, safety, credentials or organic relevance.
No external sending, publishing, spending or regulated action without separate authorization.
No private resident data, member cross-access, SRE prospect data or owner-only commercial controls.
All generated material is a draft for review; current claims must be verified before use.
